summary: On paper Minnesota has the edge (Minnesota's defense ranks 19th in EPA per dropback with motion, +0.08 allowed). The model favors Minnesota at 58%, mostly on passing matchup (2.1 pts) and starting QB (1.4 pts).

MIN.detail: Minnesota's defense ranks 19th in EPA per dropback with motion (+0.08 allowed). Tampa Bay ranks 21st (+0.08).

TB.detail: Tampa Bay ranks 21st in EPA per dropback with motion (+0.08). Minnesota's defense ranks 19th (+0.08 allowed).

team_cards.t1: Tampa Bay has the 7th-worst motion passing game.
team_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · FTN CHARTING VIA NFLVERSE
team_cards.note: Garbage time removed · MIN: n=38 dropbacks

model.summary: Model: Minnesota 58% to win, fair line MIN -2.5. Market: Minnesota 50%. The largest factor is passing matchup, worth 2.1 points toward Minnesota.

model_cards.t1: The model likes Minnesota more than the market.
model_cards.sub: Win probability. Market = vig-free moneyline at build time.
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Not betting advice · market line at build time

model_cards.sub: Each factor's push on the projected margin, in points. Positive = toward Tampa Bay. Sum = MIN -2.5.
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Linear model, so contributions are exact SHAP values · vs. an average matchup

model_cards.sub: Distribution of Tampa Bay's margin. Shaded area = Tampa Bay win (42%).
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Normal margin, sigma = 12.0 points (fit by log loss)

model_cards.t1: Tampa Bay is missing 1.5 starters' worth of snaps.
model_cards.t2: Injuries move the line 1.1 points toward Minnesota.
model_cards.sub: Players listed Out, Doubtful or Questionable, weighted by recent snap share. QBs are in the QB factor.
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Weight = snap share (last 4 games) x status (Out 1.0, Doubtful 0.85, Questionable 0.25)

model_cards.t1: The biggest unit gap: Minnesota's pass defense.
model_cards.t2: 0.06 EPA per play better than Tampa Bay's.
model_cards.sub: Opponent-adjusted EPA per play vs. league average, the inputs to the model. Right = better.
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Recency-weighted, last season's plays at 35% weight

model_cards.t2: It trails the market: Brier 0.226 vs. 0.211.
model_cards.sub: Walk-forward backtest, 2018-2025 (2087 games). Each season uses only earlier data.
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Brier score: lower is better · market = closing line
